title: Light/pale yellow Tailwind OKLCH theme update

requirements.summary: Soften the global Tailwind OKLCH theme palette to a light/pale yellow by updating the CSS variable tokens (light + dark mode) in frontend/src/index.css.
acceptanceCriteria: The global background and surfaces (background/card/popover) render as a light/pale yellow rather than a strong saturated yellow.
Primary/secondary/accent colors are visibly softer (reduced color intensity) while maintaining clear hierarchy between surfaces and interactive elements (e.g., buttons/links).
Text remains readable with sufficient contrast against the light yellow backgrounds (foreground and *-foreground tokens are set appropriately).
The updated palette applies consistently in both default and dark mode (no reversion to the previous hard yellow values).

file_operations.description: Adjust the OKLCH CSS variables for background/foreground/card/popover/primary/secondary/muted/accent/border/input/ring and corresponding *-foreground tokens to a less saturated, less intense light/pale yellow palette; update both :root and .dark blocks to ensure consistent theming across public portal + Agent Arena without touching any shadcn UI component files.
